title: ROOM TEMPERATURE SENSOR INSPECTION
ocr_text:
AC–105
AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM – SENSOR

ROOM TEMPERATURE SENSOR INSPECTION
(See page AC–28)

ROOM TEMPERATURE SENSOR INSTALLATION
Installation is in the reverse of removal.

EVAPORATOR TEMPERATURE SENSOR REMOVAL
1. REMOVE EVAPORATOR
(See page AC–82)
2. REMOVE EVAPORATOR TEMPERATURE SENSOR
Pull out the evaporator temperature sensor from the evaporator.

N08399

EVAPORATOR TEMPERATURE SENSOR INSPECTION
(See page AC–32)

EVAPORATOR TEMPERATURE SENSOR INSTALLATION
Installation is in the reverse order of removal.

AMBIENT TEMPERATURE SENSOR REMOVAL
REMOVE AMBIENT TEMPERATURE SENSOR
(a) Remove the ambient temperature sensor from the bumper reinforcement.
(b) Disconnect the connector.

N08540

AMBIENT TEMPERATURE SENSOR INSPECTION
(See page AC–30)

AMBIENT TEMPERATURE SENSOR INSTALLATION
Installation is in the reverse order of removal.
